{{Quote|Pillon Miner, he's Human&mdash;he was the first one to find out that the amphistaff polyps in that grove over there are mature enough to attack. Peritonitis. He's dying.|Jacen Solo|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Traitor">''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]''</ref>}}
'''Peritonitis''' was an inflammation of the peritoneum, the thin tissue that lined the inner wall of the abdomen and covers most of the abdominal organs. [[Pillon Miner]], a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]], was suffering from peritonitis after being injured by [[amphistaff]]s in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]].
